skala_apply_auto_detected_rules #

Undocumented export property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against the oracle at 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified Tier C — accepted and deliberately ignored. Flat at both values on a fixture whose wrapping demonstrably moves (skala_wrap_arguments_style is CONFORMANT with three distinct outputs on it). It asks the IDE to prefer rules auto-detected from the surrounding source over the configured ones, which is an editor behaviour; Tier C is confirmed and no fixture is owed.

skala_use_indent_from_vs #

Undocumented export property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against the oracle at 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified Tier C — accepted and deliberately ignored. ⚠ Observable, and decisively an editor setting: under indent_style = tab, true makes the oracle abandon the .editorconfig's tabs and emit Visual Studio's own four spaces, while false honours the file. Skala has no IDE settings to defer to, so an oracle glob would report INERT for a difference nobody intends to close. Tier C confirmed.
